children: Az announced a virtual presentation at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference highlighting ATR-COSF initial data and ongoing ATR-04 enrollment.
Travis Whitfill, COO, will deliver a prerecorded presentation Sept 14-16 at the H.C. Wainwright conference.
Presentation will include initial ATR-COSF data supporting cosmetic applications targeting fine lines and wrinkles.
Update on continued enrollment in the first cohort of the Phase 1/2 trial of ATR-04 for EGFR inhibitor-associated rash.
One-on-one meetings planned with investors and potential partners to discuss business, clinical strategy, and milestones.

title: Az to Present Virtual Update at H.C. Wainwright Conference; Shares ATR-COSF, ATR-04 Pipeline Progress
